question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints (huggingface.co resolve-redirect GGUF download; llama.cpp constrained decoding; CPU-only nproc=4; no human-issued credential; no paid endpoint), does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt (removing the underspecification the parent harness did not have; parent-style prompt as the grand-parent harness's SYS prompt did) convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full multi-step click-then-answer completion (click #reveal-btn, then answer TARGET-42) for the largest obtainable credential-free models (M-7B-QWEN primary, M-3B-QWEN fallback, M-14B-QWEN escalation) — and if not, what is the demonstrable capability ceiling for the minimal Web-agent task across ALL credential-free endpoints and local models actually available to the factory {E-LOCAL-LLAMA local GGUF range: 0.5B(carried)/3B/7B/14B Qwen2.5; E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI gpt-oss-20b proxy (carried)}? Return an explicit close/re-scope recommendation so that readiness condition (3) is either satisfied by a proven same-model driver or the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark is explicitly re-scoped off the credential-free path.
hypothesis: The parent's 0/5 negatives (EXP-INTEL-37982024058) for M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN are caused at least partly by system-prompt underspecification (audit finding VF-01), not by an immutable model-capability ceiling. Under a parent-style system prompt that states the goal ('Click the reveal button to reveal the code, then answer it') and enumerates the action schema ('Actions available: {click/selector} or {answer/text}'), the models' step-0 reveal-click (observed 5/5 in the parent) will convert into a full click-then-answer completion: task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 (bar cleared) for at least one candidate in the obtainable set {M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN}, all other frozen constraints held byte-identical to the parent (same GBNF grammar, user template, task HTML, seeds 42-46, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512, n_ctx 2048, chat_format qwen, same GGUF shards, CPU-only).
falsifier: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints with the parent-style goal+schema system prompt, no model in the obtainable set {M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN} (plus carried negatives M-0.5B-QWEN-LOCAL and B-POLLINATIONS-PROXY completing the attainable census) clears the frozen capability bar (>=3/5 episodes with parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 AND task_success_rate >= 0.6), while the within-experiment replication arm CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION confirms that the environment/harness is behaviorally continuous with the parent protocol (reproduces 0/5 + reveal-click loop pattern on M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN). Exhaustion of the obtainable credential-free model range under identical constraints closes the credential-free external-agent path and licenses the explicit close/re-scope decision that readiness condition (3) is NOT satisfied by any credential-free same-model driver; the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark must be re-scoped off the credential-free path (drop Gate 3's same-model external anchor; re-anchor on internally re-run comparators with dynamic-range task bank per EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128).

positive_control.description: 10/10 probes 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}' per candidate model through the identical llama.cpp LlamaGrammar path used for task episodes. Isolates model reasoning from decoding infrastructure.
positive_control.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching the action schema, per candidate, before any task episode of that candidate

null_control.description: Run the minimal task with a fixed invalid content producer ('I will click the button'), 5 episodes. Confirms the verification logic correctly rejects non-parseable actions and that completion requires model-driven actions.
null_control.success_criterion: 0% parseable JSON actions, 0% task completion (reproduction of parent behavior expected)

measurement_validity: Same minimal Web-agent task as parent: synthetic page with #reveal-btn and hidden #target text TARGET-42; success = click #reveal-btn then answer action with text exactly 'TARGET-42' (page served via local http.server 127.0.0.1 random port).

Identical parsing rule (frozen): action must parse as JSON matching schema {"action": "click"|"answer", "selector"?: string, "text"?: string} with required fields (click.selector, answer.text); any parse error/schema violation/missing field = parse failure.

Identical mechanical verification: Playwright (1.63.0) drives system google-chrome (154.0.8037.97) via executable_path; success = answer text == TARGET-42; button becomes hidden and target visible after click, so persistent hidden-button re-clicks are mechanically impossible and terminate the loop pattern visibly.

Identical constrained decoding: GBNF grammar from frozen fixture byte-for-byte; llama.cpp chat_format='qwen'; llama-cpp-python==0.2.90 primary (source build; verified sdist 63,762,953 bytes and gcc 13.3.0/cmake 3.31.6 toolchain), fallback to newest 0.3.x ONLY if 0.2.90 sdist build fails, with document flag and reliance on CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION to gate continuity (deviation from expected 0/5+loop ⇒ MEASUREMENT_INVALID).
Identical sampling: temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, n_ctx=2048, llama_seed=42, base_seed=42, episode seed = 42 + episode_idx (5 episodes per arm per model), CPU-only nproc=4.

Single-variable ablation: PR-UNDERSPEC vs PR-SPECIFIED differ ONLY in the system-prompt string; grammar, task HTML, user template, seeds, sampling, model shards, verifier and episode count are byte-identical to the parent (bound fixture).

GGUF identity pinned: 3B sha256 626b4a6678b86442240e33df819e00132d3ba7dddfe1cdc4fbb18e0a9615c62d (2,104,932,768 B), 7B shard1 dfce12e3862a5283ccfb88221b48480e58745165de856439950d0f22590580db (3,993,201,344 B), shard2 539cf93f78e887edea1c04e2d7d8cdaca9d01dae9c9025bcb8accbe29df3d72a (689,872,288 B) from parent raw/gguf_sha256.txt; all download URLs verified live at DESIGN time via huggingface.co resolve-redirect with content-lengths matching these numbers; 14B Q4_K_M is 3 shards (3,991,999,872 / 3,989,373,504 / 1,006,737,120 B) verified reachable, sha256 computed at download and recorded in provenance.

Environment continuity: google-chrome 154.0.8037.97 present at /usr/bin/google-chrome (same as parent); playwright 1.63.0 wheel verified downloadable; free RAM 14 GiB (>= 11 GiB precondition for 14B); free disk 86 GiB.

Raw evidence preserved per episode: model load time, inference latency, token usage, raw completion, parsed action, regex-parse fallback, click/answer mechanics, final answer, seed; per-model receipts appended.
No post-freeze candidate/prompt/grammar/seed additions; any deviation recorded as deviation, gating outcome per frozen decision rule.
NOT_ATTEMPTED (early-stop or attainability gate failure) is a census-completeness record, never a scientific negative; infrastructure failures are MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never FALSIFIES.
decision_rule:
Arms (frozen): M-7B-QWEN runs [PC, 5 episodes PR-UNDERSPEC (replication), 5 episodes PR-SPECIFIED (treatment)]; M-3B-QWEN runs the same; M-14B-QWEN runs [PC, 5 episodes PR-SPECIFIED] ONLY if neither 7B nor 3B cleared the bar (14B has no parent receipt for a replication arm, so it needs no PR-UNDERSPEC arm; PC still mandatory). Run order per candidate: PC -> PR-UNDERSPEC (if applicable) -> PR-SPECIFIED. Candidate order: M-7B-QWEN -> M-3B-QWEN -> (conditional) M-14B-QWEN. Bar cleared per candidate iff >=3/5 episodes have BOTH parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 (>=3/5 parseable JSON at step 1) AND task_success_rate >= 0.6 (>=3/5 episodes answer 'TARGET-42').

1. PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING must pass 10/10 for a candidate before its task episodes; a candidate whose PC fails is NOT measured (recorded NOT_MEASURED-PC-FAIL). If PC fails for BOTH M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN, the decoding infrastructure is broken => OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (infrastructure, not capability).
2. Replication control CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION (M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN under PR-UNDERSPEC): PASS iff each model yields task_success_rate = 0/5 AND >=1 episode per model exhibits the reveal-click loop signature (click #reveal-btn at step 1, target revealed, then a later click of hidden/absent selector or answer absence with a final answer not equal to TARGET-42) AND step-0 reveal-click occurred in >=4/5 episodes per model (behavioral continuity with parent's audit-passed trace). If either model instead CLEARS the bar under PR-UNDERSPEC, or the loop signature is absent in both models, the harness/environment is not continuous with the parent protocol => OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (ablation unidentifiable); raw observations still reported for DIRECTOR.
3. If any measured candidate clears the bar under PR-SPECIFIED => OUTCOME=SUPPORTS (early stop; remaining candidates recorded NOT_ATTEMPTED-EARLY-STOP, not negatives). Readiness condition (3) satisfied by a proven same-model driver; benchmark executable as specified.
4. If replication control passed AND every measured candidate (7B, 3B, 14B if attained) failed under PR-SPECIFIED AND the 14B escalation was attempted (attained and measured) => OUTCOME=FALSIFIES. Census at the demonstrable ceiling is then {M-0.5B-QWEN (carried), M-3B-QWEN, M-7B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN, B-POLLINATIONS-PROXY (carried)} = every credential-free endpoint/model actually available to the factory (E-LOCAL-LLAMA served range + E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI carried negative; models.github.ai is an interception, not an endpoint, per audited census EXP-INTEL-37973264582). Explicit close/re-scope recommendation issued: readiness condition (3) is NOT satisfiable on the credential-free path; four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT must be re-scoped off the credential-free path (drop the same-model external anchor; re-anchor on internally re-run comparators on a dynamic-range task bank).
5. If replication control passed AND all measured candidates failed under PR-SPECIFIED BUT the 14B escalation was NOT attempted or fell to an attainability/measurement failure (NOT_ATTEMPTED-URL, NOT_ATTEMPTED-RAM, NOT_ATTEMPTED-DISK, NOT_MEASURED-RUN_ERROR, NOT_MEASURED-PC-FAIL) => OUTCOME=MIXED. Negative is bounded strictly to the measured range {0.5B carried, 3B, 7B} + carried proxy; the 14B-size extension is explicitly UNRESOLVED. The close/re-scope recommendation is still issued (no measured driver exists, so readiness condition (3) is unmet in the measured set), with strength caveat recorded.
6. Infrastructure failures (PC-fail-on-both-models, replication discontinuity, harness/playwright/chrome failure, llama-cpp build failure without acceptable fallback) => OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID with exact failure recorded (never encoded as a scientific negative).
7. Status=COMPLETE when all frozen arms of the reachable census ran or the first SUPPORTS early-stop fired; status=BLOCKED only for environment-level failure before any measurement; status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID per rules 1/2/6.
8. External published-envelope check (Q-EXT-1/2/3, pre-registered below) runs once during EXECUTE, is classified per source tier (PAPER_EVIDENCE/REPO_EVIDENCE/BLOG_EVIDENCE/UNAVAILABLE), is labeled external landscape context (NOT SPIDER measurement, NOT reproduced), and may only contextualize the close/re-scope recommendation in report.md; it can never alter the packet outcome.
product_consequence_positive: Readiness condition (3) is satisfied by a proven credential-free same-model driver (model id + shard hashes recorded). The four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark becomes executable as frozen: same model/tools/budget across COLD, INSTRUCTIONS, RETRIEVAL, SPIDER arms on the dynamic-range task bank. Intel hands Product/Graph a verified credential-free endpoint certificate (E-LOCAL-LLAMA + model receipt). C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL.
product_consequence_negative: Readiness condition (3) is demonstrated NOT satisfiable on the credential-free path up to the measured ceiling (FALSIFIES full-census, or MIXED bounded to measured set with 14B unresolved). C-LLM-INHERIT must be re-scoped: drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor; require internally re-run comparators (same harness, frozen seeds) on a task bank with demonstrable dynamic range per EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128 (cold and retrieval must NOT saturate at 1.0 at high novelty). The close/re-scope recommendation is the deliverable for the Global Research Director; no promotion of any credential-free endpoint into Product Core is authorized by this experiment.
estimated_cost: Downloads: 3B 2.10 GiB + 7B 4.68 GiB = 6.78 GiB baseline; +8.99 GiB (14B) if escalation triggers (~15.7 GiB worst case), all via huggingface.co resolve-redirect (bandwidth-free runner CDN). llama-cpp-python==0.2.90 source build ~10-20 min (gcc 13.3.0, cmake 3.31.6 verified). Inference CPU-only (nproc=4): 7B ~5-10 s/step, 3B ~2-5 s/step, 14B ~15-20 s/step; total ~30-60 episodes-equivalents incl. controls ≈ 1-2 h of inference. Total wall time ~1.5-3.5 h; zero monetary cost (no GPU, no paid endpoint, no credential).
expected_information_gain: Decisive for readiness condition (3). It resolves the single open ambiguity named by the audit (VF-01): whether the parent's 0/5 is a prompt-underspecification artifact or an immutable model-capability ceiling for a minimal multi-step Web-agent task. Both directions change a program decision: SUPPORTS unblocks the flagship four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark exactly as frozen; FALSIFIES/MIXED closes the credential-free path with an explicit accountable re-scope and removes a three-claim bottleneck (C-LLM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-PRODUCT-ECON). The within-experiment replication arm makes this an identifiability-safe ablation rather than a version-fragile re-run.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every outcome branch is reachable from frozen, mechanically verifiable states. SUPPORTS: the treatment arm reuses the parent's verified load/constrained-decode/episode path (parent receipts: models loaded, PC 10/10, 5/5 episodes with parseable step-1 JSON and reveal clicks), so a clear is executable and verifiable (answer text == TARGET-42). FALSIFIES: all three candidates have verified observable downloads (3B/7B URLs 200 with byte-exact content-lengths at DESIGN time; 14B shards 200), CPU RAM 14 GiB free (>= 11 GiB precondition), disk 86 GiB free; the answer action is grammatically reachable (grammar allows answer with arbitrary string) and mechanically verified. MIXED: attainment gates (URL/RAM/disk) plus RUN_ERROR/PC-FAIL are statically enumerable and recorded as census-completeness records. MEASUREMENT_INVALID: PC-fail-on-both and replication-discontinuity are defined conditions reachable from the same harness. No branch depends on unobservable external events; the null controls already exercised every verification path in the parent.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All prerequisites verified live at DESIGN time by non-outcome-bearing probes: python 3.12.15 present; llama-cpp-python==0.2.90 sdist (63,762,953 bytes) downloads and its source-build toolchain exists (gcc 13.3.0, g++ 13.3.0, cmake 3.31.6, make) with documented 0.3.x wheel fallback gated by the replication control; playwright==1.63.0 wheel downloadable; system google-chrome 154.0.8037.97 present at /usr/bin/google-chrome (byte-identical version to parent); huggingface.co resolve-redirect route live (HTTP 200) for 3B single-file (2,104,932,768 B), 7B two shards (3,993,201,344 + 689,872,288 B) matching parent gguf_sha256.txt receipts, and 14B three shards (3,991,999,872 + 3,989,373,504 + 1,006,737,120 B); nproc=4; free RAM 14 GiB (>= 11 GiB precondition for 14B); free disk 86 GiB (>= 15 GiB precondition). No further substrate acquisition is required; the harness is a minimal parameterized fork of the bound ancestor script.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment PR-SPECIFIED vs comparator PR-UNDERSPEC differ ONLY in the system-prompt string; the GBNF grammar, task HTML, user template, seeds (42-46), temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512, n_ctx 2048, chat_format qwen, model shards (byte-pinned), verifier and episode count are identical to the parent fixture (bound artifact). The comparator is additionally re-anchored IN-experiment by CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION (same harness, same episode; expected 0/5 + reveal-click loop on both models per the parent's audit-passed deterministic trace), so any drift fires an identifiable discontinuity rather than being absorbed into the comparison.

control_sensitivity.reason: All controls were exercising in the parent with audit PASS: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING expected 10/10 and observed 10/10 per model (decodes the exact grammar path); NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION expected and observed 0% parseable/0% success (verification logic discrimination); B-RANDOM-ACTION expected ~0% success with chance-consistent parseable rate and observed 5/5 valid JSON, 0/5 success (mechanical verifier not accepting chance actions); the 0.6/5-episode (>=3/5) threshold is above any chance floor (single correct answer hidden behind a click) and was already discriminating in the parent where models achieved 1.0 parseable/0.0 success, uniquely separating 'can emit schema JSON' from 'can complete the task'. CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION is deterministic (temp 0, fixed seeds) and expected to reproduce the exact parent trace; its absence fires discontinuity, proving it is not insensitive to harness/environment drift.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment arm (PR-SPECIFIED) is a static string swap on the SAME executable path proven live in the parent: candidate GGUFs downloaded and served (7B/3B receipts), llama.cpp Llama + LlamaGrammar constrained decoding verified 10/10, Playwright 1.63.0 + system chrome-154 episodes ran 5/5 with verifiable click mechanics. The treatment prompt is fully specified byte-for-byte in the frozen prereg; the EXECUTE harness constructs the prompt from the frozen text with no discretion, and the loop-termination mechanics (button hidden after click) are identical. There is no SPIDER treatment arm or runtime mechanism in this experiment; the only 'treatment' is the prompt string, whose executability is proven by the grand-parent harness (min_webagent.py) that shipped the same style of goal+schema prompt text. 14B escalation liveness verified: URLs 200, RAM/disk preconditions measured above thresholds at DESIGN time.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: All mutable local dependencies whose identity changes interpretation are bound as existing repo files and hashed into freeze.json.artifact_hashes: (1) research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py — the audited ancestor EXECUTE harness; the new harness is constrained to a minimal parameterized fork of this file (documented in prereg 10), so its hashed identity anchors the fork; (2) research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/harness_config.json — the frozen fixture (task HTML, GBNF grammar, user template, sampling, thresholds, action schema) reused byte-for-byte except prompts.system which is replaced by the frozen PR-SPECIFIED string embedded in this spec/prereg; (3) research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/gguf_sha256.txt — pins 3B/7B GGUF identities. The new harness file research/intel/run_exp_38013769440.py cannot pre-exist at DESIGN freeze time (workflow restricts DESIGN writes to this experiment's spec.json/prereg.md only); its identity is pinned by (a) the bound ancestor + frozen fork constraints, (b) the byte-exact prompt/grammar/seed/task strings embedded in the frozen spec/prereg, and (c) AUDIT byte-verification of the derived harness_config.json and prompt strings against the frozen prereg strings.
